file.help: The source imported last; null before anything is imported. The bytes themselves are not stored: after a reload this holds the description, but nothing is read until a file is chosen again.

name.help: The file name; for pasted text, the name of the text input.

size.help: The size as the file card shows it: bytes as a whole number with B, kilobytes with one decimal and KB, megabytes with two decimals and MB.

formatId.help: The detected format as the file card names it, for example Text file (CSV / TSV / TXT); missing if the format was not recognised.

source.help: Where the source comes from: a chosen or dropped file, or pasted text.

options.help: The parser options per format: csv, xlsx and aqdef. Which apply in the current format is listed in activeParams; a change reads the source again.

csv.help: The options for CSV, TSV and TXT.

preset.help: The export profile, a set of defaults for the CSV export of a measuring software. Generic leaves everything at the defaults (automatic delimiter, UTF-8, column header row, no skipped rows). Zeiss CALYPSO uses semicolon, Windows-1252 and skips 4 rows, Hexagon PC-DMIS comma, UTF-8 and 4 rows, Mitutoyo MeasurLink comma, UTF-8 and no rows; all three read the first remaining row as header. A profile sets delimiter, encoding, skipped rows and column header row at once; the individual options can still be changed afterwards. Set via applyPreset; writing the field alone does not set the other options.

delimiter.help: The character that separates the columns: automatic (detected from the content), comma, semicolon, tab or pipe.

encoding.help: The encoding of the file: UTF-8, Windows-1252 (Excel) or Latin-1 (ISO-8859-1); it decides whether umlauts appear correctly. It does not apply to pasted text, which is already characters; the field is hidden then.

hasHeader.help: Whether the first row (after the skipped ones) holds the column headers. Without column headers it counts as data, and the columns are named C1, C2 and so on.

skipRows.help: Skip header rows: how many rows at the start of the file are discarded before reading; a whole number of at least 0. Meant for metadata that some measuring machines write above the table. A negative value is rejected; the previous value stays.

xlsx.help: The options for Excel and ODS.

hasHeader.help: Whether the first row of each sheet holds the column headers. Without column headers it counts as data, and the columns are named C1, C2 and so on.

encoding.help: The encoding of the Q-DAS file. The default is Windows-1252 because Q-DAS files in the DACH region are mostly saved that way; Latin-1 (ISO-8859-1) and UTF-8 are also available.

activeSheet.help: The number of the sheet the preview shows and sendToWorksheet sends, from 0. A new source resets it to 0; above the number of sheets, the last sheet applies.

activeParams.help: The option paths that apply in the current format, such as options.csv.delimiter; for pasted text without encoding, empty without a source and for JSON and MPX.

applyPreset.help: Chooses an export profile: sets delimiter, encoding, skipped rows and header row of the CSV options at once; the source is read again.

params.preset: The export profile, a set of defaults for the CSV export of a measuring software. Generic leaves everything at the defaults (automatic delimiter, UTF-8, column header row, no skipped rows). Zeiss CALYPSO uses semicolon, Windows-1252 and skips 4 rows, Hexagon PC-DMIS comma, UTF-8 and 4 rows, Mitutoyo MeasurLink comma, UTF-8 and no rows; all three read the first remaining row as header. A profile sets delimiter, encoding, skipped rows and column header row at once; the individual options can still be changed afterwards.
params.command: The command as an object with preset.

selectSheet.help: Chooses the sheet of the file whose columns are sent to the worksheet; the chosen one is highlighted.

params.index: The number of the sheet in asyncTasks.parse.value.sheets, from 0; any other number is an error.
params.command: The command as an object with index.
The task as an object with text and format.
An empty object; the task takes no arguments.

parse.help: Reads the chosen source with the options of its format; runs by itself after a new source and after every change of those options (combined, 120 ms delay). The value names format and sheets with name, row count and columns (name, type), without the values; without a source, also after a reload, it is null without error. If reading fails, the value is null and the error names the reason.

cancel.help: Cancels the running read; the preview stays as it was.

importText.help: Reads CSV or JSON text like a file and waits until parse has finished. Returns the number of sheets, or null when the parse failed; the reason is then in asyncTasks.parse.error. An empty text is a parse failure, not a rejection. If parsing takes longer than 20 seconds, the task fails.

params.text: The content as text; CSV is always read as UTF-8.
params.format: One of the formats in textFormats, csv or json; any other value is an error.

cancel.help: Stops waiting; the source is already taken over, parse keeps running.

sendToWorksheet.help: Sends the columns of the shown sheet with type and format to a new worksheet, all or nothing. Without data nothing is sent; without columns a notice appears. The value is the new worksheet; without data or columns none is created. It first waits until parse has finished and sends its result, so a start right after an option change already sends the new result. If that takes longer than 20 seconds it fails without sending.

cancel.help: Cancels the task. While it is still waiting for parse, nothing is sent; a send already under way runs to its end.
